title: Orbit logbook — evening scratch (launch edits & follow-ups)
content:
Quick evening dump — consolidate errands before tomorrow's sync. Mostly messy; leave as-is for now.

Context: prepping small launch (hosted API tweaks) for Beta cohort next week. Main focus tonight: finalize PRD wording around fallback model routing, lock down rollout cadence, and follow up with infra and legal on telemetry retention.

Top objectives for tomorrow (priority order):
- finish PRD edits (section: fallback & routing) and push to confluence; flag any ambiguous phrasing for Diego to resolve
- get infra confirmation on burst capacity numbers (need raw GPU-hour estimate)
- confirm legal's acceptability of telemetry retention for Beta customers (30d vs 90d)
- run through launch-day checklist with SRE and support (30m dry run)

PRD edits notes (what I changed / need to verify):
- Rewrite of "Compatibility fallback" paragraph to be actionable: added explicit decision table (preferred -> fallback model family -> region fallback). TODO: Diego to add the exact model family names in the table by EOD tomorrow.
- Added sentence recommending 2-tier rollout: canary 5% (2 hours), ramp to 25% (24 hours) if latency and error budgets OK. "If error_rate > 0.5% in 2h -> automatic rollback" needs Ops sign-off.
- Clarified observability hooks: must emit per-request model_variant tag + route_id. Tech debt: need to ensure SDK attaches route_id in proxy (Emily).
- Call out costs: estimated 12% uplift on token cost for first 72h due to un-optimized batching. Add note for Optimize team to provide quick config (max batch 64 -> 128?)

Meeting notes (sync with infra & SRE, 2026-03-11 10:30am):
- Infra: burst capacity request processed, but need formal commit (eta: 48h). They can reserve N 8xA100-equivalent for 6 hours/day for launch windows.
- SRE: happy to run canary rollback automation; want a playbook entry for "fallback-to-compatible-variant". SRE asked: "who owns the test prompt set for regression during canary?" -> assign to me (Asha) + Diego to compile quick set.
- Action: Diego to open Jira for playbook item and assign to oncall rotation owner (JIRA-API-791).

Stakeholder follow-ups (to ping / status):
- Legal (Maria): sent question about telemetry; left voicemail. Pending reply. If no reply by noon tomorrow, escalate to Tony in compliance.
- Customer Success (Priya): asked for one-page launch notes for customers (public-facing). Draft due before Friday. Priya will draft FAQs; I will review for technical accuracy.
- Solutions Eng (Tom): needs sample curl examples using streaming + tool-calling. Put on Diego's radar.

Launch checklist (condensed personal running list — for me to tick off):
- [ ] Finalize PRD edits + publish (confluence)
- [ ] Confirm infra commit for burst capacity (email infra lead)
- [ ] Legal sign-off on telemetry retention
- [ ] Create canary regression prompt set (5–10 prompts) and store in repo
- [ ] SRE dry run scheduled and confirmed (30m)
- [ ] Support runbook drafted for customer escalations
- [ ] Public one-pager for Beta customers
- [ ] Monitor cost uplift post-launch and share Optimize recommendations

Risks / parking lot: 
- Telemetry retention disagreement could block Private-mode customers from joining Beta -> contingency: offer a toggle for telemetry collection and document feature gate.
- If infra cannot commit burst GPUs, fallback is region-based throttling, which increases latency for some tenants. Note to product: communicate degraded latency to CS.
- Rollback automation complexity: if rollback triggers, need graceful client-facing messaging to avoid confusion (support + product coord).

Notes to self / quick heuristics: 
- When writing PRD, prefer "owner + timeframe" instead of vague verbs. Eg: instead of "infra will do X" -> "infra (Diego) will provide X by 2026-03-12 17:00 PT".
- Keep checklist bite-sized — can never trust memory during launch.

Unresolved questions (to surface at triage):
1) Should we allow customer-specific telemetry retention overrides in Beta? Pros: removes blocker for enterprise customers. Cons: increases operational complexity.
2) Can Optimize ship a fast quantization profile for one popular model variant within 48 hours? Quick win if yes.
3) Who is oncall for the first 6 hours post-rollout? Need explicit names + pager handover.

Tiny editorial TODOs for PRD: 
- Replace passive voice in "routing will be handled" line -> active owner.
- Add inline example of fallback sequence for a user request that hits capacity (3-step).
- Add link to SDK PR that attaches route_id once merged (placeholder currently).

End-of-day micro-retro: 
- Wins: cleaned up the routing doc, SRE engagement felt solid, infra gave a realistic path to burst capacity.
- Misses: legal reply not yet in, still fuzzy telemetry decision.
- Fix for tomorrow: block 45m after lunch to finish legal escalation if needed.

Random capture: potential name for this mini-launch: "Orbit Beta" (keeps the theme). Might make it easier to tag things in Jira and slack.

Parking links mentioned above:
- PRD draft: CONFLUENCE-PRD-ORBIT (placeholder)
- Jira: JIRA-API-784 (capacity), JIRA-API-791 (playbook), JIRA-API-800 (legal telemetry)
- Draft public one-pager: github.com/redwood-inference/orbit/papers/one-pager-draft.md

--
Small, messy, actionable. If I come back tomorrow and this hasn't changed, follow the checklist in order.

Asha
